- keyname: about
  field_type: author_bio
  name: About This Plugin
  description: Displays an authentic full-screen Game Boy Pocket 8-bit Christmas countdown. Scene selection and rotation modes include Santa's flight with 8 reindeer, chimney drops, elf workshop, snow globe, and winter cabin.

  field_type: select
  name: Display Mode
  options:
  - Fixed Scene: fixed
  - Rotate Automatically: rotate
  default: fixed

  field_type: select
  name: Scene (if Fixed)
  options:
  - 'Scene 1: Santa, Sleigh & 8 Reindeer': santa_sleigh
  - 'Scene 2: Chimney Rooftop Drop': chimney_drop
  - 'Scene 3: Elf Toy Workshop': elf_workshop
  - 'Scene 4: Giant North Pole Tree': giant_tree
  - 'Scene 5: Cozy Snow Globe': snow_globe
  - 'Scene 6: Winter Forest Cabin': cabin_retreat
  - 'Scene 7: Train to the North Pole': polar_express
  - 'Scene 8: Retro 8-Bit Christmas Stocking': giant_stocking
  default: santa_sleigh
- keyname: rotation_interval
  field_type: select
  name: Rotation Interval (if Rotating)
  options:
  - Every Hour: hourly
  - Every Day: daily
  default: daily
- keyname: scene_offset
  field_type: number
  name: Quick Cycle Step (Advance Scene)
  default: 0
  help_text: Change this number anytime to jump to the next scene without changing modes.

","half_vertical.liquid":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}
{% assign now_ts = "now" | date: "%s" | plus: offset %}
{% assign cur_year = now_ts | date: "%Y" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_hour = now_ts | date: "%H" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign manual_step = scene_offset | default: 0 | plus: 0 %}
{% assign mode = display_mode | default: "fixed" %}
{% if mode == "rotate" %}
  {% assign r_interval = rotation_interval | default: "daily" %}
  {% if r_interval == "hourly" %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | times: 24 | plus: cur_hour | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% else %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% endif %}
{% else %}
  {% assign sel = selected_scene | default: "santa_sleigh" %}
  {% if sel == "santa_sleigh" %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% elsif sel == "chimney_drop" %}{% assign scene_index = 1 %}
  {% elsif sel == "elf_workshop" %}{% assign scene_index = 2 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_tree" %}{% assign scene_index = 3 %}
  {% elsif sel == "snow_globe" %}{% assign scene_index = 4 %}
  {% elsif sel == "cabin_retreat" %}{% assign scene_index = 5 %}
  {% elsif sel == "polar_express" %}{% assign scene_index = 6 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_stocking" %}{% assign scene_index = 7 %}
  {% else %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% endif %}
  {% assign scene_index = scene_index | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign now_ts = "now" | date: "%s" | plus: offset %}

{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_hour = now_ts | date: "%H" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign manual_step = scene_offset | default: 0 | plus: 0 %}
{% assign mode = display_mode | default: "fixed" %}
{% if mode == "rotate" %}
  {% assign r_interval = rotation_interval | default: "daily" %}
  {% if r_interval == "hourly" %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | times: 24 | plus: cur_hour | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% else %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% endif %}
{% else %}
  {% assign sel = selected_scene | default: "santa_sleigh" %}
  {% if sel == "santa_sleigh" %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% elsif sel == "chimney_drop" %}{% assign scene_index = 1 %}
  {% elsif sel == "elf_workshop" %}{% assign scene_index = 2 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_tree" %}{% assign scene_index = 3 %}
  {% elsif sel == "cabin_retreat" %}{% assign scene_index = 4 %}
  {% elsif sel == "polar_express" %}{% assign scene_index = 5 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_stocking" %}{% assign scene_index = 6 %}
  {% elsif sel == "snow_globe" %}{% assign scene_index = 7 %}
  {% else %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% endif %}
  {% assign scene_index = scene_index | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
{% endif %}

  description: An authentic, richly detailed Game Boy Pocket 1-bit pixel art Christmas countdown with 8 distinct cinematic winter scenes, dithering patterns, and hero countdown present.

  name: Display Mode
  options:

  default: fixed

  field_type: select
  name: Scene (if Fixed)
  options:
  - '1. Santa Flight & 8 Reindeer': santa_sleigh
  - '2. Chimney Rooftop Descent': chimney_drop
  - '3. North Pole Elf Toy Workshop': elf_workshop
  - '4. Giant Town Square Tree': giant_tree
  - '5. Cozy Winter Forest Cabin': cabin_retreat
  - '6. North Pole Express Steam Train': polar_express
  - '7. Fireside Hearth & Stockings': giant_stocking
  - '8. Enchanted Snow Globe': snow_globe
  default: santa_sleigh
- keyname: rotation_interval
  field_type: select
  name: Rotation Interval (if Rotating)
  options:
  - 'Every Hour': hourly
  - 'Every Day': daily
  default: daily

  field_type: number

  default: 0
  help_text: Increment or adjust this number anytime to instantly flip through scenes while testing.

    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}

  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}

{% endif %}

{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign manual_step = scene_offset | default: 0 | plus: 0 %}
{% assign mode = display_mode | default: "fixed" %}
{% if mode == "rotate" %}
  {% assign r_interval = rotation_interval | default: "daily" %}
  {% if r_interval == "hourly" %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | times: 24 | plus: cur_hour | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% else %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% endif %}
{% else %}
  {% assign sel = selected_scene | default: "santa_sleigh" %}
  {% if sel == "santa_sleigh" %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% elsif sel == "chimney_drop" %}{% assign scene_index = 1 %}
  {% elsif sel == "elf_workshop" %}{% assign scene_index = 2 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_tree" %}{% assign scene_index = 3 %}
  {% elsif sel == "cabin_retreat" %}{% assign scene_index = 4 %}
  {% elsif sel == "polar_express" %}{% assign scene_index = 5 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_stocking" %}{% assign scene_index = 6 %}
  {% elsif sel == "snow_globe" %}{% assign scene_index = 7 %}
  {% else %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% endif %}
  {% assign scene_index = scene_index | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
{% endif %}

    {% assign mode = display_mode | default: "hero_grid" %}

              {% elsif idx == 12 %}<use href="#icon-holly" />
              {% elsif idx == 13 %}<use href="#icon-mitten" />

            <rect x="0" y="92" width="86" height="68" fill="url(#dither-light)" />
            <rect x="8" y="104" width="70" height="44" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
            <text x="43" y="132" font-family="monospace" font-size="18" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000">#{{ idx | plus: 1 }}</text>

        {% endfor %}
      {% endfor %}

      <!-- Footer ribbon with Days Left -->
      <rect x="15" y="440" width="770" height="25" fill="#000" />

    {% else %}
      <!-- Balanced Layout: 12-16 Grid Icons + Prominent Hero Countdown Box -->
      <!-- Left: 4x3 Grid (12 icons) or 4x4 Grid in landscape with Hero -->
      <!-- Icon Grid: 4 columns x 3 rows on the left (x: 25 to 500) -->

      <g transform="translate(125, 275)"><use href="#cell-box" /><use href="#icon-snowman" x="11" y="11" /></g>
      <g transform="translate(225, 275)"><use href="#cell-box" /><use href="#icon-holly" x="11" y="11" /></g>

      <line x1="530" y1="61" x2="530" y2="465" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 4" />

        <rect x="4" y="4" width="220" height="378" rx="6" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="220" height="378" rx="6" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="3" />
        
        <!-- Header Strip -->
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="220" height="36" rx="4" fill="#000" />
        <text x="110" y="24" font-family="monospace" font-size="14" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" letter-spacing="3">COUNTDOWN</text>

        <!-- Pattern Infill Header -->
        <rect x="12" y="48" width="196" height="56" fill="url(#dither-check)" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
        <rect x="20" y="54" width="180" height="44" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
        <text x="110" y="81" font-family="monospace" font-size="13" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000" letter-spacing="2">DAYS UNTIL</text>

        <!-- Massive Hero Number -->
        <rect x="12" y="114" width="196" height="150" rx="4" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="16" y="118" width="188" height="142" rx="3" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
        <text x="110" y="226" font-family="monospace, 'Courier New'" font-size="{% if days_left >= 100 %}80{% elsif days_left >= 10 %}98{% else %}116{% endif %}" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000">{{ days_left }}</text>

        <!-- Banner Label -->
        <rect x="12" y="274" width="196" height="44" fill="#000" />
        <text x="110" y="302" font-family="monospace" font-size="18" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" letter-spacing="3">CHRISTMAS</text>

        <!-- Bottom Micro Icons & Date -->
        <rect x="12" y="328" width="196" height="38" fill="url(#dither-light)" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" />
        <text x="110" y="352" font-family="monospace" font-size="13" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000" letter-spacing="1">★ DEC 25 ★</text>
      </g>
    {% endif %}
  </svg>
</div>

  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}

  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}

  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}

<div style="width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;padding:0;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;">

        <rect x="40" y="28" width="12" height="6" rx="2" fill="url(#hv-dither)" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
        <rect x="24" y="44" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="url(#hv-dither)" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
        <rect x="34" y="44" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="url(#hv-dither)" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />

{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign rot_mode = scene_rotation | default: 'single' %}
{% assign active_scene = selected_scene | default: 'sleigh' %}

{% if rot_mode == 'rotate_daily' %}
  {% assign scene_idx = cur_yday | modulo: 5 %}
  {% if scene_idx == 0 %}{% assign active_scene = 'sleigh' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 1 %}{% assign active_scene = 'icons' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 2 %}{% assign active_scene = 'hearth' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 3 %}{% assign active_scene = 'cabin' %}{% else %}{% assign active_scene = 'northpole' %}{% endif %}
{% elsif rot_mode == 'rotate_hourly' %}
  {% assign scene_idx = cur_hour | modulo: 5 %}
  {% if scene_idx == 0 %}{% assign active_scene = 'sleigh' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 1 %}{% assign active_scene = 'icons' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 2 %}{% assign active_scene = 'hearth' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 3 %}{% assign active_scene = 'cabin' %}{% else %}{% assign active_scene = 'northpole' %}{% endif %}
{% endif %}

","half_vertical":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}
{% assign now_ts = "now" | date: "%s" | plus: offset %}
{% assign cur_year = now_ts | date: "%Y" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

<div style="width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;padding:0;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;">

- keyname: scene_rotation

","full.liquid":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}
{% assign now_ts = "now" | date: "%s" | plus: offset %}
{% assign cur_year = now_ts | date: "%Y" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_hour = now_ts | date: "%H" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign rot_mode = scene_rotation | default: 'single' %}
{% assign active_scene = selected_scene | default: 'sleigh' %}
{% if active_scene == 'northpole' %}
  {% assign active_scene = 'workshop' %}
{% endif %}

{% if rot_mode == 'rotate_daily' %}
  {% assign scene_idx = cur_yday | modulo: 5 %}
  {% if scene_idx == 0 %}{% assign active_scene = 'sleigh' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 1 %}{% assign active_scene = 'workshop' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 2 %}{% assign active_scene = 'icons' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 3 %}{% assign active_scene = 'hearth' %}{% else %}{% assign active_scene = 'cabin' %}{% endif %}
{% elsif rot_mode == 'rotate_hourly' %}
  {% assign scene_idx = cur_hour | modulo: 5 %}
  {% if scene_idx == 0 %}{% assign active_scene = 'sleigh' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 1 %}{% assign active_scene = 'workshop' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 2 %}{% assign active_scene = 'icons' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 3 %}{% assign active_scene = 'hearth' %}{% else %}{% assign active_scene = 'cabin' %}{% endif %}
{% endif %}

","half_vertical.liquid":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}
{% assign now_ts = "now" | date: "%s" | plus: offset %}
{% assign cur_year = now_ts | date: "%Y" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

<div style="width:800px;height:480px;margin:0;padding:0;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;">

    <!-- ==================== SCENE 0: SANTA & 8 REINDEER ==================== -->

    <!-- ==================== SCENE 1: CHIMNEY ROOFTOP DELIVERY ==================== -->

{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}

{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign manual_step = scene_offset | default: 0 | plus: 0 %}
{% assign mode = display_mode | default: "fixed" %}
{% if mode == "rotate" %}
  {% assign r_interval = rotation_interval | default: "daily" %}
  {% if r_interval == "hourly" %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | times: 24 | plus: cur_hour | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% else %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% endif %}
{% else %}
  {% assign sel = selected_scene | default: "santa_sleigh" %}
  {% if sel == "santa_sleigh" %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% elsif sel == "chimney_drop" %}{% assign scene_index = 1 %}
  {% elsif sel == "elf_workshop" %}{% assign scene_index = 2 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_tree" %}{% assign scene_index = 3 %}
  {% elsif sel == "cabin_retreat" %}{% assign scene_index = 4 %}
  {% elsif sel == "polar_express" %}{% assign scene_index = 5 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_stocking" %}{% assign scene_index = 6 %}
  {% elsif sel == "snow_globe" %}{% assign scene_index = 7 %}
  {% else %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% endif %}
  {% assign scene_index = scene_index | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
{% endif %}

  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}

{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}

  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

Astronomy Picture of the Day

Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer.

2026 November 20

V-G-R
Image Credit & Copyright: Apostolos Kyriazis

Explanation: Explanation: On November 17, fans of interstellar spaceflight around planet Earth were invited to shine a message into the night sky. Traced by a flashlight beam switched on and off, the dashes and dots of a Morse code message captured in this time exposure from the Emirates Astronomical Observatory are read V-G-R. That's a call sign for the Voyager 1 spacecraft currently in interstellar space some 26 billion kilometers away. How long did it take the message to reach humanity's most distant interstellar spacecraft? Traveling at the speed of light, the answer is one day. In fact, the Voyager 1 spacecraft was confirmed to reach its one light-day distance milestone on November 18, at 10:16:07 UTC, nearly 50 years after launch in 1977. For extra credit, fans of math can calculate that at one light-day per 50 years, Voyager 1 will reach its one light-year (365 light-days) distance milestone in about 18,250 years.
